messages:
Asha (ml): FYI nightly eval flagged a big drop for the new PTQ-onboard candidate (ptq-v2.1) on the 'customer-faq' promptset. EM down ~12% vs fp16 baseline. attaching quick numbers.

eval-bot: nightly-eval | model=ptq-v2.1 promptset=customer-faq EM=0.771 baseline=0.879 delta=-0.108 ppl=3.4 -> 6.8 :rotating_light:

Mike (eng): Reproduced locally on my machine with the same quant artifacts. Failures look concentrated on numeric/list formatting and bullet preservation.

Li (quant): Can you paste a representative failing example? also share the quant config (scale type, symmetric/asymmetric).

Asha (ml): Example below (shortened):
Input: "How many items are in the refund policy list?"
Baseline (fp16): "There are 4 items: 1) Eligibility, 2) Time window, 3) Exceptions, 4) Contact."
PTQ-v2.1: "There are several items. Check the policy page for details."

Asha (ml): Config excerpt: ```
ptq_config: { method: static, per_channel: true, clip: 2.5, dtype: int8, packed_kv: true }
```

Jonah (infra): Any difference in KV layout or serialization between packed_kv and prior runs? packed_kv change landed in infra last week.

Mike (eng): I traced generation tokens — the KV cache lengths look fine. The mismatch seems to occur after layernorm output quantization: tails are flattened -> early stop of list tokens.

Li (quant): This smells like scale clipping on layernorm post-activation. With per-channel + clip=2.5 we may be saturating rare high-magnitude channels that carry list separators / punctuation.

Asha (ml): Agreed. Also saw higher perplexity on a handful of prompts with numeric sequences.

Mike (eng): Quick mitigation proposal: rollback ptq-v2.1 from nightly canary and pin onboarding to ptq-v2.0 until we add a targeted unit/eval for list/numerical fidelity. rollback window can be immediate for the nightly runner. :+1:

Li (quant): Proposed fixes: 1) increase clip to 3.5 or use percentile-based clipping (99.9th). 2) run a focused calibration that includes comma/number-heavy examples. 3) add a differential token-level test to the onboarding harness.

Asha (ml): Canaries/gating rules we should add before re-onboard:
- Run customer-faq promptset (N=200) with EM and token-precision metrics.
- Reject candidate if EM drop > 5% OR mean token-precision drop > 0.08
- Smoke on 50 numerics/list prompts must have exact match rate within 2% of baseline

Jonah (infra): I can wire the gating in the onboarding pipeline. Will add a canary stage that submits evaluation job and fails fast. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: note | scheduled rollback for nightly-runner -> ptq-v2.0 at 1754323000 unless cancelled.

Asha (ml): Action items: 
- Li: run new calibration with percentile clipping + report metrics (ETA: 24h)
- Mike: add 50 focused numeric/list tests to onboarding and token-precision check (ETA: 48h)
- Jonah: implement gating step in onboarding CI (ETA: EOD tomorrow)
- Asha: prepare canary rollout plan and rollback playbook for SRE (ETA: 12h)

Mike (eng): I'll also add a small synthetic test harness to fuzz punctuation rounding for PTQ paths.

Li (quant): If percentile clipping fixes it we can re-run full nightly and only promote after passing canary and a 48h stability window.

Asha (ml): OK let's rollback the nightly to ptq-v2.0 now and follow the action items. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

Jonah (infra): Rollback executed for nightly-runner -> ptq-v2.0. Notified CI: https://ci.internal/runs/1754322999

Asha (ml): keeping thread open for Li/Mike updates. If anyone notices other promptset classes affected (e.g., table rendering, code blocks) ping here and we'll expand the focused checks.

Mike (eng): noted. will post PR when tests are in.

Li (quant): will post calibration results and histogram plots in ~20h.

Asha (ml): Thanks — moving to follow-up channel once the fixes land. :rocket:
